svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A ring of concrete 450 mm wide and 250 mm deep, top at ground level,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred under the 305 mm wall. Outside 3,155 x 2,255 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: inside 2,255 x 1,355 mm. The setting-out plan gives every line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Peg out the outside corners; check both diagonals are equal.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dig the trench 450 wide and 250 deep; go deeper to firm ground if

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bottom is soft, and fill back with concrete, not soil.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pour, rod out air, strike the top level all round within 5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Keep it damp under a sheet for 7 days before laying bricks.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay a plastic damp-proof strip 305 mm wide on top, under both

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: leaves and the cavity, lapped 150 mm at the joins.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: level within 5 mm all round; diagonals within 10 mm.
